answer: A referral graph works like an insurance network: every newcomer needs a voucher from an existing identity, and the voucher shares the risk. Admission needs a referral from an identity older than 30 epochs with 80 reputation points. The voucher stakes 100 credits, and a proven fake costs the voucher the stake plus 25 points. A glacier moves slowly, and so does trust: each identity may vouch for 3 newcomers per epoch. An island of 1,000 fakes needs 334 distinct vouchers, and a star cluster is flagged when one voucher backs over 10 newcomers. The anchor is the public graph.
